title: fxv branch retire/restore command payload
description: Payload schema for the `fxv branch retire` and `fxv branch restore` commands' JSON output. Both report the same fields.

branch.description: The branch's displayed form: a bare name for a global branch, '<username>/<name>' for a user branch.

retired.description: The branch's status after the command: true if retired, false if active.

changed.description: False when the branch was already in the requested state, in which case nothing was written.

published.description: Whether the change reached the published ledger, and so is visible to everyone, rather than staying local to this workspace.
